change_summary: Replaced the tl.dot-based K-loop (BLOCK_K=16, EVEN_K=False, masked loads) with a tl.static_range(2) outer-product loop that loads a_col=[BLOCK_M] and b_row=[BLOCK_N] per k-step and accumulates via a_col[:,None]*b_row[None,:], eliminating shared memory staging and 12-way bank conflicts. Updated autotune configs to include num_warps=1 and num_warps=2. Removed BLOCK_K, EVEN_K, ALLOW_TF32 constexprs.
